kapak.alt: An affected father and his sons

youtube.baslik: Can a father pass an X-linked change to his son? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Because males have only one X chromosome, an X-linked recessive change shows its effect directly in males; thanks to the working copy on their second X chromosome, females are mostly carriers. For each son of a carrier mother, the chance of being affected is 50 percent. An affected father cannot pass the change to his sons, but all his daughters will be carriers.
